text: Bought as amazon warehouse deal. Product was quite a .... Bought as amazon warehouse deal. Product was quite a bit more damaged than what I was prepared for. We needed to use the shelf and did not want to take the time to return. My husband was able to bend back the pieces decently they will work at least.

product_metadata.title: Edsal 7216H Steel Commercial Shelving Unit, 36" Width x 72" Height x 16" Depth
features: Standing five-shelf unit made of steel to support 500-lb. total capacity
Shelves adjust in 1-1/2" increments to accommodate height of stored items
Double cross-braces on the back and cross-braces on the sides for rigidity
Gray enamel finish to resist corrosion
Nut and bolt assembly with instructions, nuts, and bolts included; tools for assembly sold separately
description: Shelving unit. Made of steel. Gray color. Measures 36" width by 72" height by 16" depth.
